review.none: No questions are due for review right now.
review.help: Wrongly answered questions come back once at the end of the round. Correct → next box (after 1, 2, 4, 7 days).
exam.intro: {n} mixed questions from all sections. No explanations during the exam; results at the end.
progress.resetConfirm: Delete all progress, review boxes, "learned" marks, Lesen scores, Coach and Schreiben scores? ("My phrases" stay.) This cannot be undone.
cards.noPhrases: No phrases yet. Add them with "➕ Add to cards" in the Schreiben evaluation.
timer.examStop: ⏱ 2:00 — in the exam you may be stopped here
api.busy: Server busy, try again in 10 s
api.noModel: Model not found — check the model name in Settings
api.noKey: No API key — add one in Settings
api.refusal: The model declined this request, change the text and try again
fallback.title: Fallback mode
fallback.hint: After copying, open the Claude app, paste into a new chat and send.
fallback.copied: ✅ Copied. Now paste it into the Claude app and send.
fallback.copyFailed: Could not copy — select and copy the text manually.
settings.professionHelp: Claude tailors the feedback to this profession. Explanations come in your chosen language; corrections and model texts stay in German.
settings.apiKey: API key (stored only on this device)
settings.noKeyHelp: Without a key the Coach screens run in fallback mode: the prompt is copied and pasted into the Claude app.
settings.monologHelp: The Coach monologue and the Sprechen card timers use this length. In the exam you may be stopped after 2 min.
settings.delKeyConfirm: Delete the API key from this device?
coach.noKey: No API key → fallback mode (copy prompt → Claude app).
mono.dictate: Tap 🎤 on the keyboard and speak again.
mono.noKey: No API key. After writing the text, copy the prompt and paste it into the Claude app.
rec.info: The recording stays on the phone for this session only; it is never sent anywhere.
rec.unsupported: This device/browser does not support audio recording. Use dictation directly instead.
t2.help: Claude is a colleague and uses "du". {n} turns. Answer → reason → example → question back (Und du?).
t3.pick: Pick a situation or let Claude invent a new workplace problem.
t3.help: Claude is your colleague: find a solution together, share tasks, discuss long-term measures. {n} turns.
t3.needKey: Generating a new situation needs an API key — pick one from the list.
chat.dictate: Tap 🎤 on the keyboard, speak, then send.
chat.turnsDone: All turns done — you can evaluate now.
chat.continueInApp: You can continue the conversation in the Claude app.
chat.noKey: No API key. Copy the role-play prompt and have the conversation in the Claude app (voice mode works too).
write.checklistHelp: Most points come from here: every item must be in the text.
write.pointCustomer: Answer every point of the customer's complaint
write.pointsHelp: Tick each point as you add it on paper.
write.outlineHelp: Not a finished text: a goal + sentence starters for each paragraph.
write.noPhrases: None yet — save them with "➕ Add to cards" after an evaluation.
write.outlineNoKey: No API key. For a plan, copy the prompt and paste it into the Claude app.
write.noKeyIntro: No API key → text input + fallback mode (copy prompt → Claude app). For reading from photos:
write.bsIntro: Write a formal reply to the customer using the boss's instructions ({n} min).
write.forumIntro: In the exam you get two topics and pick one ({n} min).
write.simIntro: Like in the exam: pick one of two topics and write it in {n} min.
write.last5: ⏱ Last 5 min — check the task points
write.noKeyPhoto: Reading from photos needs an API key (Settings). Type the text you wrote on paper below.
write.trWarn: ⚠️ Fix unreadable spots, but don't correct your own mistakes.
write.unclear: {n} unreadable spots — check the photo, fix them, then delete the [?] mark.
write.evalNoKey: No API key. After writing, copy the prompt (task + text) and paste it into the Claude app.
write.textFirst: Upload or type the text first.
write.pagesInfo: {n}/{max} pages. Is the order right? Delete a wrong page with ×.
write.photoHelp: Make the whole page visible, shoot straight on and in good light. Up to {max} pages. Photos are never stored.
write.tooMany: Up to {max} pages — {n} photos were not added.
write.photoFailed: This photo could not be opened, take it again.
write.readFailed: try again or continue with "⌨️ Type the text".
write.blurry: The photo isn't sharp, retake it in better light and straight on.
